configurePresets.name: mingw-w64-cross
configurePresets.description: Uses native/toolchains/mingw-w64-x86_64.cmake; outputs *.exe under build-mingw-w64/. Requires g++-mingw-w64-x86-64 (or matching CYPHA_MINGW_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX). No CUDA (MinGW + nvcc unsupported).

configurePresets.name: wsl-gcc-release
configurePresets.displayName: WSL / Linux — GCC Release (recommended native tree)
configurePresets.description: Single build directory native/build-wsl-gcc. Install: build-essential cmake ninja-build libsqlite3-dev. Optional Qt: qt6-base-dev; optional CUDA: nvidia-cuda-toolkit + -DCYPHA_ENABLE_CUDA=ON.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-release
configurePresets.description: Build tree native/build-windows-msvc. Requires VS 2022 + CMake. Optional Qt: add -DCYPHA_BUILD_QT=ON -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=C:/Qt/6.x.x/msvc2022_64

configurePresets.name: windows-vs2026-release
configurePresets.displayName: Windows — MSVC x64 (Visual Studio 2026 / Build Tools 18)
configurePresets.description: Same as windows-msvc-release but generator Visual Studio 18 2026 (MSVC 14.5x). Use a separate binaryDir if both VS versions are installed.
